content.text: InstagramLog InSign UpCloseNever miss a post from wwda_auSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Sign upLog inwwda_au•FollowMore optionswwda_au 1wToday is World Autism Awareness Day!This year’s theme, ‘Autism and Humanity – Every Life Has Value’, reminds us that neurodivergence needs to be valued and recognised in every area of life to create inclusive communities and fair policies for all.Autistic women, girls and gender-diverse people often experience layered discrimination and stigma, including barriers to healthcare, education, safety and economic security. These inequalities are worsened by gender bias, ableism and a lack of accessible, trauma-informed support.Today, and every day, we continue to advocate for inclusion and systemic change.[Image: this tile has a purple to blue gradient background, with a line drawing of two women in the bottom-right corner.
